Taylor Swift has become one of the NFL’s most talked-about supporting players. After showing up to cheer on her  new husband, Travis Kelce , at the Chiefs’ first two games of the season, Swift could potentially be in Sin City on Sunday, Oct. 4, as Kansas City takes on the Las Vegas Raiders. The game kicks off at 4:25 p.m. ET and will air live on CBS, while fans without cable can stream it through several platforms that offer free trials to eligible customers.

Swift has already brought plenty of star power to Arrowhead this season. She attended the Sept. 14 game  against the Denver Broncos alongside Tom Cruise then returned for the Sept. 20 match-up with the Indianapolis Colts. When Kelce scored his first touchdown  of the season, Swift pointed to her wedding ring  and shouted, “That’s my husband!” Will Swifties get the same energy in Las Vegas?

The Chiefs and Raiders have been rivals since the AFL’s inaugural 1960 season and have faced each other more than 125 times since. Kansas City has historically held the edge in the series. Sunday’s matchup carries added significance because both teams enter Week 4 at 3-0, marking the first time the division rivals have met while both were undefeated through their first three games.
